shortDescription: Module for setup of SystemReport Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: archive_ref
options.description: Relative path to the report archive file on filesystem.the archive includes exported system configuration and current object as json. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: controller_patch_image_ref
options.description: Controller patch image associated with the report. It is a reference to an object of type image. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: downloadable
options.description: Indicates whether this report is downloadable as an archive. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: dryrun_info
options.description: Dry-run report. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: events
options.description: List of events associated with the report. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: image_ref
options.description: System image associated with the report. It is a reference to an object of type image. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the report derived from operation in a readable format. Ex  upgrade_system_1a5c. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: obj_state
options.description: Report state combines all applicable states. Ex  readiness_reports.system_readiness.state. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: operation
options.description: Nature of operation. Ex  controller upgrade, system patch, etc. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: readiness_reports
options.description: Readiness state of the system. Ex  upgrade pre-check results. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: se_patch_image_ref
options.description: Se patch image associated with the report. It is a reference to an object of type image. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: summary
options.description: Summary of the report. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tasks
options.description: List of tasks associated with the report. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Tenant uuid associated with the object. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of report. Pre-checks, dry-run or an upgrade operation. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid identifier for the report. Field introduced in 22.1.6, 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.
